svg.title: iOS · Projects · sync panel (Project Syncing) · uploads · portrait
svg.desc: Mirrors App/ProjectSharingChip.swift (ProjectSharingSheet → uploadsBlock, uploadButton, uploadTitle, uploadDetail) over App/PicPlace/PicPlaceUploadJobs.swift (PicPlaceController.uploadJobRows). A VARIANT of projects.sharing.portrait.svg — the same sheet, drawn 2026-09-24 from the Mac Debug build Steven signed off the same day (code first). A person's uploads of originals are JOBS: each one the drawer holds gets a row in one white rx12 card between the status line and Check PicPlace now (under the sending block when a push run shows one — not drawn: no run here). ROW: the state as the title (15pt medium) — Uploading originals · Upload paused · Waiting for Wi-Fi · Upload interrupted · Upload stopped · Upload waiting — the project name under it (caption, secondary), a linear bar (accent while the run goes, secondary grey while held; bytes done of total), one caption line of counts and why (… · what reached PicPlace stays — Resume sends the rest / … · Only on Wi-Fi is on — it goes when Wi-Fi is back / the reason · goes again on its own / the error; running: counts, and · mobile data allowed when overridden), then the buttons on a line of their own, trailing: Pause while it runs; held, Cancel (bordered, secondary) beside Resume · Use mobile data (this upload only, never the setting) · Try again (bordered, accent). The buttons moved off the title line after the first Mac screenshot cut Waiting for W… and Use mobi…. Drawn here: two jobs held with auto-sync waiting for Wi-Fi — the state of the signed-off screenshot (LL_SYNC_PANEL=1 LL_PICPLACE_NETWORK=cellular -letslapse.picplace.wifiOnly YES over jobs staged in the root's PicPlace/sync-state.json). Everything under the card is the base file's, 280pt lower; the sheet scrolls, so the code and QR run off the bottom. Bordered buttons are drawn as capsules (iOS 26+); the Mac draws them as rounded rects.
